Great food, service could be better
Oct 2019
This place in in the same multi-story building as the Cau Go restaurant (which is one floor above), the two restaurants share the entrance and the lift. The food here was just as excellent as Cau Go. The service was a bit inept at times - for example, the waitress forgetting to bring the drink order, and too few waiters on the floor. But the staff were very friendly and had a good attitude. I was sitting inside but right by the window, which meant that I had an excellent view of the lake. This place is easier to get to on weekends than Cau Go, so you probably have a better chance of getting a good table here at busy times.

Great view and enjoyable drinks
Oct 2019
My friend and I were looking for a bar with a good view, enjoyable atmosphere and good, affordable drinks, this describes perfectly Avalon! It was a great experience, the drinks are quite cheap and very good. The staff really amazed me. I was suffering from a sore throat and asked to not have ice in my drink. The waitress came back and gave me not just a drink with nearly no ice but also a pill for my throat. Words can not describe how thankful I was for this kind lady. On our way out after we have paid she came to me and gave me a whole box of pills, saying that she too has sore throat often and would love to help, she didn't even let me pay. I definitely recommend this place not only because of the drinks and view but also because there you will find a person who works with their heart and soul and this is such a rare thing nowadays.

Menu pictures show larger portions

The position of the Avalon couldn't be better. Situated across from the lake it makes this restaurant a pleasant place for a meal. I chose the ribs and while the presentation was good the ribs are very small and tough. I wouldn't have it again. My wife choose the beef rice noodle dish and she loved it.
